selection.metric: Acc(arm, DEV-QA, learned), fact-level mean aggregation
selection.excluded: any configuration with a non-finite loss or score

training_contract.example_order: one permutation of the corpus per epoch from Random(rng_rule(TRAIN_SEED, 'order:<epoch>'))
training_contract.sequence: one statement per sequence; pad on the right to the longest sequence in the batch; padding excluded from the loss
training_contract.warmup: linear from 0 over the first 15 steps
training_contract.scheduler: cosine from the peak to 10% of the peak at step 300
training_contract.weight_decay: per SEARCH_SPACE for F; 0.0 for L and A; applied to 2-D weight matrices only
training_contract.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 master weights
training_contract.checkpoint_policy: only the final checkpoint of a run is kept and evaluated; no intermediate checkpoint is used for anything
training_contract.primary_training_token_budget: 20 passes over the 120 TRAIN statements for F, L, A and S (identical statements up to the S permutation); Y: 20 passes over its 240 sentences with batch 16 (300 steps); Y tokens / F tokens must lie in [0.80, 1.25]

N.name: No-learning
N.definition: the pinned base model, no parameter update

L.name: LoRA
L.definition: base frozen; LoRA on q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj of all 28 layers; alpha = 2 * rank; dropout 0; B initialised to 0

A.name: Full FT + anchor
A.definition: F plus lambda * KL(p_base || p_theta) on general anchor text, 4 anchor documents per step

S.name: Shuffled-label
S.definition: TRAIN statements with the answers permuted among learned facts of the same relation and stratum (derangement)

Y.name: Style-only
Y.definition: per learned fact one entity-only and one answer-only sentence (templates Y_ENTITY, Y_ANSWER), never in the same sequence
